eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Ten
subtitle: Lesson 86 · Window and Ranking Functions

code:
SELECT OrderDate, TotalDue,
  SUM(TotalDue) OVER (
    ORDER BY OrderDate
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    AS RunningTotalDue
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader;
caption: Every TotalDue so far, added up, ordered by OrderDate.

eyebrow: A moving average: the frame slides
code:
SELECT OrderDate, TotalDue,
  AVG(TotalDue) OVER (
    ORDER BY OrderDate
    ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    AS SevenRowMovingAverage
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader;
caption: Current row plus the 6 before it — a 7-row moving average.

code:
SUM(TotalDue) OVER (
  PARTITION BY SalesPersonID
  ORDER BY OrderDate
  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
) AS RunningTotalPerSalesPerson
caption: PARTITION BY restarts the running total at zero per salesperson.

code:
OVER() / PARTITION BY  ->  the foundation
ROW_NUMBER/RANK/DENSE_RANK/NTILE  ->  ranking
LAG/LEAD  ->  compare neighboring rows
FIRST_VALUE/LAST_VALUE  ->  edges of the window
ROWS vs. RANGE  ->  controlling the frame
Running totals/moving averages  ->  the payoff
caption: The complete window-function toolkit, start to finish.
